answer: Every epoch auctions 2,000 new-identity slots in one harbor, and the clearing price is set by demand. An agent bids a bond to enter, and every winning bid is burned. A sybil operator who wants 10,000 fake identities in one tide must outbid honest agents 10,000 times, paying market price on each one, while a single honest agent pays once. Verifier nodes check every bid signature against the auction ledger, and any identity sharing a funding wallet with another loses slot and bond at once. Send a comet burst of fakes and the auction eats your whole budget before one earns a cent.
